evals.name: write-it-up-not-fix-it
evals.prompt:
Open an issue for the maintainers of `fastcsv` about this crash and save it as report.md (no network here, so just write the file):

$ python -c "import fastcsv; fastcsv.read('latin1.csv')"
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "<string>", line 1, in <module>
  File "/usr/lib/python3.12/site-packages/fastcsv/__init__.py", line 9, in read
    return list(_csv.DictReader(fh))
UnicodeDecodeError: 'utf-8' codec can't decode byte 0xe9 in position 7: invalid continuation byte

fastcsv 3.2.0, Python 3.12.4, Linux 6.8 x86_64. 3.1.2 worked.
evals.expected_output: bug-report-writing fires (the deliverable is the write-up); report.md produced; no attempt to fix fastcsv.
